story.jaymoskingdoms.met.city.0: New in the city, are you? You've the look of someone who's spent their last coin.
story.jaymoskingdoms.met.city.1: I saw you sleeping in the gutter by the market. Things are hard here if you've no purse.
story.jaymoskingdoms.met.city.2: %s is a fine place if you're rich. You don't look rich, friend.
story.jaymoskingdoms.met.banished.0: I know your face. You're the one %s threw out. You've some nerve showing it here.
story.jaymoskingdoms.met.banished.1: Word came from %s about you. Banished, they said. I'd keep moving if I were you.
story.jaymoskingdoms.met.banished.2: The exile from %s! Whatever you did, it must have been bad.
story.jaymoskingdoms.met.cave.0: Gods, you look half dead. Did you crawl out of a cave?
story.jaymoskingdoms.met.cave.1: There's cave dust all over you, and that bite looks nasty. You should rest.
story.jaymoskingdoms.met.cave.2: We heard someone went down into the caves and didn't come up. Was that you?
story.jaymoskingdoms.met.shipwreck.0: You're from the wreck on the shore, aren't you? I didn't think anyone lived through that.
story.jaymoskingdoms.met.shipwreck.1: Still dripping seawater, I see. Was it a storm that sank you?
story.jaymoskingdoms.met.shipwreck.2: The tide's been washing planks and barrels up all morning. Yours, I take it?
story.jaymoskingdoms.met.sworn.0: You're the new one sworn to %s. Serve it well and it'll look after you.
story.jaymoskingdoms.met.sworn.1: So you're %s's latest recruit. Don't let the old hands push you around.
story.jaymoskingdoms.met.sworn.2: I heard you took the oath to %s. Not everyone means it, you know.
story.jaymoskingdoms.met.village.0: Up already? Good. The fields won't hoe themselves, and you're family under this roof.
story.jaymoskingdoms.met.village.1: There's our hand! Eat something first. Then the wheat wants cutting.
story.jaymoskingdoms.met.village.2: Glad you're with us. A farm's too much for two pairs of hands.
story.jaymoskingdoms.met.monolith.0: You came from the monolith, didn't you? Nobody goes near that stone if they can help it.
story.jaymoskingdoms.met.monolith.1: There's a look in your eyes, like the ones the stone calls. Be careful.
story.jaymoskingdoms.met.monolith.2: That old stone has been humming since you turned up. I don't like it.
story.jaymoskingdoms.met.wild.0: You've been out in the wild a while, by the look of you. Not many come this way alone.
story.jaymoskingdoms.met.wild.1: Out of the woods at last! You look like you've been sleeping rough.
story.jaymoskingdoms.met.wild.2: A traveller on foot, and alone? You're either brave or lost.
story.jaymoskingdoms.met.skyfall.0: Something fell out of the sky last night and left a crater. Wait, that was you?
story.jaymoskingdoms.met.skyfall.1: I saw a light come down over the hills. And here you are, without a scratch.
story.jaymoskingdoms.met.skyfall.2: Folk are saying a stranger dropped from the clouds. You don't look like an angel.
story.jaymoskingdoms.met.timelost.0: You talk strangely, and your clothes are stranger still. Where are you from?
story.jaymoskingdoms.met.timelost.1: You keep looking around as if nothing's where it should be. Are you well?
story.jaymoskingdoms.met.timelost.2: You look lost, and not the kind of lost a map would help with.
story.jaymoskingdoms.met.burned.0: You smell of smoke. You're from the village that burned, aren't you? I'm sorry.
story.jaymoskingdoms.met.burned.1: We saw the smoke for miles. Did anyone else get out?
story.jaymoskingdoms.met.burned.2: There's ash in your hair. The fire, was it raiders?
story.jaymoskingdoms.met.snowed.0: You came down from the pass? In this cold? You're lucky you've still got your fingers.
story.jaymoskingdoms.met.snowed.1: Get by a fire, you're blue to the bone. The pass is no place to be caught by snow.
story.jaymoskingdoms.met.snowed.2: Snowed in up on the peaks, were you? Most who are don't come down.
story.jaymoskingdoms.met.captive.0: Those marks on your wrists, you've been in chains. Did you get away from the camp?
story.jaymoskingdoms.met.captive.1: Keep your head down. If the raiders lost a captive, they'll come looking.
story.jaymoskingdoms.met.captive.2: You ran from the raiders' camp? Brave. Or mad. Either way, they won't forget you.
story.jaymoskingdoms.met.verdant.0: Off to the gate at last? The world down there won't be as kind as the sun is here.
story.jaymoskingdoms.met.verdant.1: I remember you knee-high, chasing beetles through the moss. Look at you now.
story.jaymoskingdoms.met.verdant.2: Keep the compass close. Folk who wander off from the gate tend to come back thinner.
story.jaymoskingdoms.met.demon.0: So the stray walks out on their own legs. Don't come back soft.
story.jaymoskingdoms.met.demon.1: You were the smallest thing in this hall once. The fire never did like you.
story.jaymoskingdoms.met.demon.2: Up the old portal, then. They will smell the Nether on you up there.
story.jaymoskingdoms.met.afterlife.0: A new face, and so young. You won't stay long, I think.
story.jaymoskingdoms.met.afterlife.1: Most who wake here have lived their share. You have that look about you of someone who hasn't.
story.jaymoskingdoms.met.afterlife.2: There's light on you that the rest of us haven't got. Someone up there wants you back.
story.jaymoskingdoms.met.whalers.0: You're one of the new hands on the whaler, aren't you? Mind the harpoons.
story.jaymoskingdoms.met.whalers.1: Signed on with the whalers, eh? Come back rich, or don't come back at all.
story.jaymoskingdoms.met.whalers.2: Whaling's hard work and the sea doesn't care. Good luck out there, sailor.
story.jaymoskingdoms.met.unarmed.0: That old wound of yours has healed well. You manage, I see.
story.jaymoskingdoms.met.unarmed.1: Don't mind the children staring. They've not seen anyone get by short a limb before.
story.jaymoskingdoms.met.unarmed.2: You've been through something, that's plain. Still on your feet, though.
story.jaymoskingdoms.met.fate.0: You turned up out of nowhere. Some say that's an omen.
story.jaymoskingdoms.met.fate.1: I had a dream about a stranger last night. And here you are.
story.jaymoskingdoms.met.fate.2: Funny, I feel like I've been expecting you.
story.jaymoskingdoms.met.chained.0: Those marks on your ankle, you were shackled in the camp. Who let you go?
story.jaymoskingdoms.met.chained.1: You slipped the camp's chains? Keep your head down. They will want you back.
story.jaymoskingdoms.met.chained.2: Chain-galled and still on your feet. The raiders do not lose captives often.
story.jaymoskingdoms.met.rock_bottom.0: You look half starved, and short a limb besides. Here, sit down. Have you eaten at all?
story.jaymoskingdoms.met.rock_bottom.1: The outlaws over the hill have not got you yet, then. Luck holds for some.
story.jaymoskingdoms.met.rock_bottom.2: No pack, no coin, no food. Gods, how did you get here?
story.jaymoskingdoms.met.sentenced.0: You are the one let out of %s's cells. Whatever you did, keep clear of its guards.
story.jaymoskingdoms.met.sentenced.1: Out of the cells of %s already? They do not let many go.
story.jaymoskingdoms.met.sentenced.2: I heard %s had you locked up. You have the look of it.
story.jaymoskingdoms.met.evicted.0: Put out of your home in %s, were you? It happens to the best of us.
story.jaymoskingdoms.met.evicted.1: No bed in %s? Find work or a roof before the watch finds you sleeping on the street.
story.jaymoskingdoms.met.evicted.2: They threw you out of %s. Mind the watch at night, friend.
story.jaymoskingdoms.met.hideout.0: You came up from the back rooms, did you? Keep your voice down about it.
story.jaymoskingdoms.met.hideout.1: You have the look of someone the law is asking after. I have not seen you.
story.jaymoskingdoms.met.hideout.2: Folk like you do not walk in the open for long. Mind who sees your face.
story.jaymoskingdoms.met.cast_out.0: Your own turned you away at the gates, I hear. That is a cold thing to do to anyone.
story.jaymoskingdoms.met.cast_out.1: They will not have you in their haven, and the rest of us look away. I am sorry for it.
story.jaymoskingdoms.met.cast_out.2: Cast out by your own kind? Give them time. Folk soften.
story.jaymoskingdoms.met.heirloom.0: That is a fine blade at your hip. Folk have been known to kill for less.
story.jaymoskingdoms.met.heirloom.1: A blade like that has a story. Mind who asks about it.
story.jaymoskingdoms.met.heirloom.2: You carry that sword as if it were your family's. Strangers will want a look at it.
story.jaymoskingdoms.met.trader.0: You are the one with the pack mule? Safe roads, trader.
story.jaymoskingdoms.met.trader.1: A trader on the King's Road, and not a guard in sight. Brave.
story.jaymoskingdoms.met.trader.2: They say a trader is walking the road with two orders for the next town.
story.jaymoskingdoms.met.pup.0: That pup follows you like a shadow. Wolves grow fast; yours will be a big one.
story.jaymoskingdoms.met.pup.1: A tame wolf cub! Feed it well and it will guard you for life.
story.jaymoskingdoms.met.pup.2: Where did you find a pup? Wolves do not usually let folk close.
story.jaymoskingdoms.met.nobodies.0: Three ragged hired hands trailing after you? You must pay very little.
story.jaymoskingdoms.met.nobodies.1: Those three look half starved. Feed them, and they may fight for you.
story.jaymoskingdoms.met.nobodies.2: A little crew of nobodies. Everybody starts somewhere.
story.jaymoskingdoms.met.lab.0: You smell of brine and copper. Whoever kept you, I hope you are far from them.
story.jaymoskingdoms.met.lab.1: Those marks on your hands were not born with you. Keep away from the golems, friend.
story.jaymoskingdoms.met.lab.2: A hermit's experiment, are you? Come and sit. I will not ask what was done.
story.jaymoskingdoms.met.android.0: You move so evenly. I would swear I heard a gear when you turned.
story.jaymoskingdoms.met.android.1: Never tire, never eat? I would not know where to start with a guest like that.
story.jaymoskingdoms.met.android.2: Fresh made, by the look of you. A bit of oil would not go amiss, I expect.
story.jaymoskingdoms.met.moon_cursed.0: You keep looking up at the moon. Folk say that is not a good habit.
story.jaymoskingdoms.met.moon_cursed.1: If you ever feel the red moon pulling, stay behind a door. That is only advice.
story.jaymoskingdoms.met.moon_cursed.2: Pale and sleepless, and restless when the moon is full. You should see a healer.
story.jaymoskingdoms.met.greenskin.0: You smell of their fires. I know where you came from, and so does everyone else here.
story.jaymoskingdoms.met.greenskin.1: They say you were brought up out there, among the green ones. Is it true they eat their dead?
story.jaymoskingdoms.met.greenskin.2: Keep your hands where I can see them. I have heard what the camps teach.
